nodes.label: When LLMs Meet Vector Databases: A Survey (review)
Vector DB as External Knowledge Store for RAG
nodes.rationale: Store chunks outside the model and retrieve at query time instead of retraining/fine-tuning on frequently changing data; providing retrieved context is distinct from changing parametric knowledge.

nodes.label: Semantic Cache (GPT-Cache)
nodes.rationale: Reuse answers of semantically similar past queries to skip LLM API calls; benefit only holds when cache hits are correct, and reuse policy cannot be decided by vector similarity alone (time, user, access scope).

nodes.label: ANN Index / HNSW
nodes.rationale: Avoid O(dN + N log k) brute-force cost; trades exactness (recall) for speed and memory.

nodes.label: Vector Compression (PQ) vs Recall Trade-off
nodes.rationale: 1536-dim vector ~6KB, 1B vectors ~6TB; dimension reduction/PQ reduces storage but lossy compression lowers recall.

nodes.label: Lost in the Middle: How LMs Use Long Contexts (review)
Controlled Position/Length Evaluation Protocol
nodes.rationale: Keep question, gold doc and distractors fixed and only move the gold document position, isolating position effect from content; max context length alone does not show the model can use it.

nodes.label: Reader Accuracy Saturates Before Retriever Recall
nodes.rationale: Going from 20 to 50 retrieved docs gives only ~1-1.5% gain; suggests reranking and truncation of retrieved lists.

nodes.label: Module / Sub-module / Operator Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Describe RAG as a computational graph so both functions and their connections (routing, branching, loops) are explicit; Naive RAG is a special case of Advanced, which is a special case of Modular (expressiveness claim, not accuracy claim).

nodes.label: Naive RAG and Advanced RAG Paradigms
RAG Flow Patterns (linear, conditional, branching, loop, tuning)
Retriever-Generator Joint Tuning (LSR, RA-DIT, KL alignment)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLMs: A Survey (review)
RAG vs Prompt Engineering vs Fine-tuning
nodes.rationale: RAG favors knowledge updates at the cost of retrieval latency and document management; FT adapts behavior/format but needs training for new facts; the two can be combined.

nodes.label: Retrieval Granularity, Chunking and Metadata Indexing
Context Curation (reranking, compression under token budget)
RAG Evaluation (context relevance, faithfulness, answer relevance; RGB, RAGAS, ARES, TruLens)
Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning (review)
Self-Consistency Decoding (sample paths, majority vote)
nodes.rationale: Marginalize over reasoning paths by voting on parsed final answers instead of trusting one greedy path; no training needed but inference cost grows with number of samples.

nodes.label: Length-normalized Weighted Sum vs Majority Vote
Arithmetic/Commonsense Benchmarks (GSM8K, SVAMP, AQuA, CSQA, StrategyQA, ARC)
Self-RAG: Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection (review)
Reflection Tokens (Retrieve, ISREL, ISSUP, ISUSE)
nodes.rationale: Separate relevance (ISREL) from support (ISSUP) because a relevant doc may not support a specific sentence; usefulness is independent of factuality.

nodes.label: Critic Model Distilled from GPT-4 Labels
nodes.rationale: Precompute critiques offline so generator trains with plain LM objective, avoiding costly PPO reward-model calls; critic not needed at inference.

nodes.label: Generator Training with Masked Retrieved Passages
SEMSCORE: Automated Evaluation via Semantic Textual Similarity (review)
SEMSCORE Metric (cosine of sentence embeddings)
nodes.rationale: Single reference responses penalize valid paraphrases under lexical overlap metrics; encode response and reference independently and compare direction in embedding space. Strong at model-level ranking, weaker for individual response judgment.

nodes.label: Baseline Metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, BLEURT, BARTScore, DiscoScore, G-Eval)
Kendall tau / Pearson r with Human Rankings
Encoder and Pooling Ablation (mean pooling vs CLS)
Take a Step Back: Evoking Reasoning via Abstraction (review)
Step-Back Abstraction (high-level question/principle first)
nodes.rationale: Retrieve the reusable principle or broader fact set before solving; unlike decomposition (one-to-many), abstraction maps many specific questions to one higher-level question. Original question must be kept for the final step.

nodes.label: Step-Back + RAG (retrieve with original and step-back query)
Error Taxonomy (Principle, Factual, Math, Context Loss, Reasoning)
Benchmarks (MMLU Physics/Chemistry, TimeQA, SituatedQA, MuSiQue, StrategyQA)
TigerVector: Vector Search in Graph Databases for Advanced RAGs (review)
Embedding Type and Co-partitioned Embedding Segments
nodes.rationale: Separate storage avoids moving large vectors during vacuum; matching partitioning with vertex segments keeps graph+vector ops local; metadata compatibility checked at compile time.

nodes.label: Graph-pattern Pre-filtering via Bitmap
nodes.rationale: Post-filtering can return fewer than k results and force retries, and can change accumulator semantics; graph engine evaluates P(v) first and passes a candidate bitmap.

nodes.label: MVCC Vector Deltas with Async Delta/Index Merge
nodes.rationale: Index build (>30s per 1M) is far slower than delta export (<1s), so commit path is decoupled from HNSW updates; queries search snapshot plus unmerged visible deltas.

nodes.label: TigerVector vs Milvus/Neo4j/Neptune Benchmarks (SIFT/Deep, LDBC SNB)
When More Cores Hurts: Vector Database Scaling Paradox in HPC (review)
Lifecycle Bottleneck Shift (insert, index, query)
nodes.rationale: Extra HPC resources speed index building but WAL/write paths and broadcast-gather result merging remain bottlenecks, so searchability time, index stabilization, recall and tail latency must be measured together.

nodes.label: Segment Count as Hidden Recall-Cost Knob
WAL / Update-queue Backpressure in Insert Path
Mixed Insert-Query Workload and P99 Latency
Research Interests (Diffusion, Flow Matching, Vision, VLM/VLA)
In-browser Embedding Paragraph Search (assets/search/ask.js)
nodes.rationale: Finds semantically close paragraphs even without lexical overlap; runs entirely in the browser sending nothing to a server; model downloaded once then cached.

nodes.label: Tag-linked Post Graph (graph-data JSON + assets/js/graph.js)
nodes.rationale: Posts sharing tags are linked; node color by top-level category; data emitted via Liquid loop over site.posts.

nodes.label: Image Editing Learning Path (DiffusionCLIP ... Drag Your Noise)
Zotero Paper Map (family/task/kind clusters, first-author links)
nodes.rationale: Papers have multiple traits, so three clustering axes are offered; data from site.data.library rendered by assets/js/library-graph.js.
